subject: Renewal uplift — installment billing, co-term alignment, and discount ask
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Feld <mfeld@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Renewal uplift — quarterly budget ask and co-term question

Hi Tessa,

Hope you're well — as we discussed on the call, Pioneer’s usage has spiked this quarter and we're looking to lock in an uplift to our Redwood capacity ahead of renewal. A few asks from my side:

- Can you provide an uplift quote that can be split across multiple invoices to align with our quarterly budget cycles? Ideally 3 installments over the next 9 months.
- We want to co-term this uplift with our existing enterprise contract that expires 2028-03-31 — can you pro-rate the first partial period?
- Any flexibility on a targeted volume discount? We were hoping for something in the 7–10% range given the jump in committed capacity.

I've attached our month-to-date usage export for July so you can size the uplift. Procurement (cc'd) will need an invoice schedule and formal quote to move a PO.

Thanks — Elena

Elena Rossi
Director, AI Product
Pioneer Health

Attachment: pioneer_usage_jul01.csv (usage snapshot)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal uplift — Pioneer — quick internal

Ben / Kim — forwarding Elena's note. Quick thoughts:

- Pioneer is asking for 3-installment billing and co-term to 2028-03-31. Usage shows ~2.5x average monthly throughput.
- Can we do a targeted 8% volume discount on the uplift portion for the first 12 months (competing ask was 7–10%)? Might be best to offer an onboarding credit to protect unit economics.
- Proposal idea: 3 equal invoices (sign, +90d, co-term prorated final) with pro-rated capacity start. Provide amortization schedule and a DocuSign-ready quote.

Can you draft numbers and a suggested legal/payment workaround if procurement insists on net-60?

Thanks — Tessa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal uplift — Pioneer — quick internal

Agree with the approach. Suggested commercial terms (high level):

- Uplift: +150% committed tokens (translates to ~120 GPU-hours/week additional) for 12 months.
- Discount: 8% on the uplifted committed capacity for the first 12 months.
- Installments: 3 equal invoices — Invoice 1 on signature (covers first 120 days pro-rated to co-term start), Invoice 2 at day 90, Invoice 3 on co-term effective date (2028-03-31) final reconciliation pro-rate.
- Payment terms: We can accept Net-60 for Pioneer, but require the first invoice to be due Net-30 to help with cashflow; alternatively offer a small 1.5% fee if all invoices are Net-60.
- Onboarding credit: $10k credit applied to first invoice to subsidize migration and SLA onboarding.

I'll pull together the numbers and a quote PDF. If Procurement pushes for Net-60 across the board we can accept if legal signs off on the PO referencing the HubSpot deal id and DocuSign.

-Ben
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Pioneer Health Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 08:45:00 +0200
Subject: Proposal: uplift installments + co-term (quote attached)

Hi Elena / Markus / Procurement team,

Thanks for the note and the usage snapshot — we put together a proposal that aims to meet your budget cadence while keeping the uplift economics clean. Summary below and attached: 

- Uplift scope: +150% committed capacity for 12 months (details in attached quote).
- Commercial: 8% discount on uplift capacity for the first 12 months.
- Billing schedule (3 installments):
  1) Invoice 1: On signature — covers initial pro-rated period through 2027-09-30 (amount = 1/3 of uplift total, less $10k onboarding credit).
  2) Invoice 2: 90 days after invoice 1 date.
  3) Invoice 3: Final reconciliation on co-term date 2028-03-31 (pro-rate adjustments if actual usage differs).
- Payment terms: We can accept Net-60 across all invoices contingent on a PO that references the HubSpot deal id (RDW-2027-0432). If Pioneer prefers Net-30 for the first invoice we can accommodate without the onboarding credit.

Attachments: pioneer_uplift_quote_v2.pdf, uplift_amortization_schedule.xlsx
DocuSign link for the order form: https://docusign.com/rdw/1234-sign

If this works, procurement can issue PO referencing PO# field and we will route to finance. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk the schedule.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Pioneer Health Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pioneerhealth.com>, Markus Feld <mfeld@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:30:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Proposal: uplift installments + co-term (quote attached)

Tessa / Ben,

Thanks for the proposal. A couple of procurement items before we can issue a PO: 

1) Please provide a revised quote that explicitly lists invoice milestones with calendar dates (we need them for our internal approval flow).
2) Pioneer Finance needs Net-60 on all invoices (no Net-30 exceptions). Will Redwood accept Net-60 across the board?
3) Please confirm the tax treatment and provide the W-8/W-9 equivalent and SOC 2 attestation link for our security/compliance team.
4) We will issue PO# PHE-78432 once the revised quote is received and the DocuSign order form is countersigned.

Can you send the revised quote by EOD Wednesday so we can get this into next week's board procurement bundle?

Procurement Team
Pioneer Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Pioneer Health Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pioneerhealth.com>, Markus Feld <mfeld@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal: uplift installments + co-term (quote attached)

Hi Procurement team — thanks for the clear asks. Confirming below and attaching the revised quote (pioneer_uplift_quote_v2.pdf) with explicit milestone dates. Summary of changes: 

- Invoice milestones (calendar dates):
  • Invoice 1: On countersignature (expected 2027-07-20) — amount = 1/3 uplift total minus $10,000 onboarding credit.
  • Invoice 2: 2027-10-18 (90 days after invoice 1).
  • Invoice 3: 2028-03-31 (co-term reconciliation invoice).
- Payment terms: Redwood will accept Net-60 on all three invoices for Pioneer Health. We will note PO# PHE-78432 on invoices; please include HubSpot deal RDW-2027-0432 in the PO text.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report link: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-2026.pdf (accessible to signed NDA holders). We'll provide W-8/W-9 as part of onboarding.

Attaching revised amortization schedule (uplift_amortization_schedule.xlsx). DocuSign link updated in the PDF.

If you confirm acceptance we will issue the DocuSign order form for countersignature.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pioneer_uplift_quote_v2.pdf, uplift_amortization_schedule.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Feld <mfeld@pioneerhealth.com>, Pioneer Health Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:02:00 +0200
Subject: Signed order form and PO# — PHE-78432

Tessa / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I have countersigned the DocuSign order form and Procurement has uploaded PO# PHE-78432 (attached). Finance confirmed Net-60 across all invoices and will route payment after PO matching.

Next steps I expect on our side: onboarding kickoff with Ben to confirm provisioning schedule, and finance will expect Invoice 1 to reference PO# PHE-78432 and HubSpot RDW-2027-0432.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting capacity up and running.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director, AI Product | Pioneer Health

Attachment: pioneer_po_78432.pdf
